27th Taipei Film Festival Nomination Party

Actress Chang Shih-ying attended the Taipei Film Festival’s nomination party at Zhongshan Hall, standing gracefully in a pink satin dress and white ankle boots. sources.description:
Press Conference for "婚內失戀"

A poised woman in a black outfit and dangling earrings reads from her notes at a podium, announcing the upcoming stage play "婚內失戀." Behind her, a screen displays the date "2022.4.23" and the venue "誠品信義 (臺北市信義區)."

Adapted from Dr. 鄧惠文's book, the play will run for ten performances starting April 23 at the Eslite Xinyi Store's 6th-floor theater. The press conference featured Dr. 鄧惠文 alongside cast members 吳世偉, 杜思慧, 張詩盈, 陳彥達, 張念慈, and 黃俊傑. Through interwoven dialogues of couples married for 5, 15, and 30 years, the production explores the nuances of marital life and the concept of "in-marriage heartbreak."

sources.description:
開鏡儀式上的喜慶場景

張詩盈身著黑白條紋洋裝，面帶微笑地站在一張擺滿祭品的紅色桌前。桌上有香燭、金色酒杯、蘋果、香蕉與零食，象徵劇組祈求順利開拍的傳統儀式。背景的紅色橫幅上以大字書寫「成功路上 大吉」，並列出導演吳建新、製作人陳南宏與主要演員王識賢、李程彬、張詩盈等名單。

這場儀式於2024年6月12日在台灣舉行，為華視與公視台語台新戲《成功路上》正式開鏡。該劇設定於1989年的台灣，講述男性成長的故事。李程彬在劇中飾演「劉建中」，並為角色加入「8+9」的生活習慣，增添角色的真實感與時代氛圍。

sources.description:
Winnie Chang Portrait

Winnie Chang, a Taiwanese actress known for her breakout role in the film 《父後七日》, appears in a high-contrast black-and-white portrait. She wears a sheer black top with a modern cut, her hair slicked back to accentuate her facial features and winged eyeliner.

Graduating from the Taipei National University of the Arts’ drama department, Chang’s poised expression and minimalist styling reflect her refined stage and screen presence. The stark white background and close framing draw attention to her elegant posture and confident gaze.
